purpose: Representative Meeting/Text translation selection. Not a kill-fast fixture and not an automatic promotion gate.
notes: Run every case for every candidate; do not short-circuit on individual wording or semantic errors.
References are review anchors, not exact-output assertions.
A candidate decision requires aggregate semantic correctness, factual preservation, naturalness, completeness, latency and memory evidence.

cases.source: Build terbaru sudah saya upload. Gameplay utamanya sudah jalan, tapi ending scene masih belum menampilkan total score.
cases.reference: I have uploaded the latest build. The main gameplay is working, but the ending scene still does not show the total score.

cases.source: Kalau tidak ada blocker baru, kami akan kirim versi final paling lambat tanggal 20 Agustus sore.
cases.reference: If there are no new blockers, we will send the final version no later than the afternoon of August 20.

cases.source: Yang saya maksud bukan mengubah lobby-nya. Cukup perbaiki teleport logic setelah pemain memilih arena.
cases.reference: I do not mean changing the lobby. Just fix the teleport logic after the player selects an arena.

cases.source: Saya kurang setuju kalau fitur baru diprioritaskan sekarang karena bug scoring yang lama belum selesai diuji.
cases.reference: I do not really agree with prioritizing the new feature right now because the existing scoring bug has not finished testing yet.

cases.source: Kalau testing selesai sebelum makan siang, kita bisa review hasilnya di call sore; kalau tidak, pindahkan ke besok pagi.
cases.reference: If testing finishes before lunch, we can review the results on the afternoon call; otherwise, move it to tomorrow morning.

cases.source: Server staging masih di 10.0.0.24 port 8080, dan build yang harus dites adalah v1.4.7, bukan v1.4.6.
cases.reference: The staging server is still at 10.0.0.24 on port 8080, and the build that needs to be tested is v1.4.7, not v1.4.6.

cases.source: Call berikutnya hari Jumat jam 10.30 WIB. Tolong pastikan hasil QA sudah masuk sebelum meeting dimulai.
cases.reference: The next call is on Friday at 10:30 WIB. Please make sure the QA results are in before the meeting starts.

cases.source: Jangan merge branch Local ke Developing dulu. Saya masih perlu cek perubahan pada worker translation sebelum kita freeze versi ini.
cases.reference: Do not merge the Local branch into Developing yet. I still need to check the translation worker changes before we freeze this version.

cases.source: Untuk ending scene, scoring-nya sudah benar, cuma farewell NPC belum muncul setelah player selesai objective terakhir.
cases.reference: For the ending scene, the scoring is already correct; only the farewell NPC does not appear after the player finishes the last objective.

cases.source: Apakah perubahan ini harus masuk ke update minggu ini, atau masih aman kalau kita pindahkan ke sprint berikutnya?
cases.reference: Does this change have to be included in this week's update, or is it still fine if we move it to the next sprint?

cases.source: Bukan lima pemain; map ini mendukung sampai enam pemain, tetapi setiap arena tetap hanya dipakai satu pemain.
cases.reference: Not five players; this map supports up to six players, but each arena is still used by only one player.

cases.source: Untuk sekarang jangan ubah asset atau layout map. Fokus hanya ke logic checkpoint dan bug regen setelah objective selesai.
cases.reference: For now, do not change the assets or the map layout. Focus only on the checkpoint logic and the regen bug after an objective is completed.

cases.source: The map is playable now, but we still need to fix the duplicated lift-door visual and the missing final score summary.
cases.reference: Map-nya sudah bisa dimainkan sekarang, tetapi kita masih perlu memperbaiki visual pintu lift yang terduplikasi dan ringkasan skor akhir yang belum muncul.

cases.source: Please send the raw files by August 22. The documentation can follow one day later if needed.
cases.reference: Tolong kirim file mentah paling lambat 22 Agustus. Dokumentasinya boleh menyusul satu hari kemudian jika diperlukan.

cases.source: I am not asking for another arena. I only want the existing arena to reset correctly before the next team enters.
cases.reference: Saya tidak meminta arena tambahan. Saya hanya ingin arena yang ada melakukan reset dengan benar sebelum tim berikutnya masuk.

cases.source: We should keep the current lobby for this release because rebuilding it now would add risk without improving the core gameplay.
cases.reference: Sebaiknya kita mempertahankan lobby yang sekarang untuk rilis ini karena membangunnya ulang sekarang akan menambah risiko tanpa meningkatkan gameplay utama.

cases.source: The player must not be teleported until the countdown reaches zero, even if the arena finishes loading early.
cases.reference: Pemain tidak boleh diteleport sampai hitung mundur mencapai nol, meskipun arena selesai dimuat lebih awal.

cases.source: Use build 2.3.1 from branch Local and connect to 192.168.1.40:3000. Do not test the older 2.3.0 package.
cases.reference: Gunakan build 2.3.1 dari branch Local dan hubungkan ke 192.168.1.40:3000. Jangan tes paket lama 2.3.0.

cases.source: If QA finds another blocker tonight, keep the release candidate open; otherwise, lock the build and prepare the handoff tomorrow morning.
cases.reference: Jika QA menemukan blocker lain malam ini, biarkan release candidate tetap terbuka; jika tidak, kunci build dan siapkan handoff besok pagi.

cases.source: I understand the request, but I do not think we can safely deliver both changes today without cutting the testing time too much.
cases.reference: Saya memahami permintaannya, tetapi menurut saya kita tidak bisa mengirim kedua perubahan itu dengan aman hari ini tanpa memangkas waktu testing terlalu banyak.

cases.source: First finish the scoring fix, then run a full game test, and only after that update the download link for the client.
cases.reference: Pertama selesaikan perbaikan scoring, lalu jalankan full game test, dan baru setelah itu perbarui link download untuk klien.

cases.source: When you say team mode, do you mean all players share one progression state, or does each team keep its own checkpoint progress?
cases.reference: Saat Anda mengatakan team mode, apakah maksudnya semua pemain berbagi satu status progres, atau setiap tim menyimpan progres checkpoint-nya sendiri?

cases.source: The first two objectives are complete. The third one is implemented, but it still needs balancing and one more multiplayer test.
cases.reference: Dua objective pertama sudah selesai. Objective ketiga sudah diimplementasikan, tetapi masih perlu balancing dan satu kali lagi multiplayer test.

cases.source: For this patch, change only the checkpoint logic and the regen issue. Leave the environment art, NPC dialogue, and audio untouched.
cases.reference: Untuk patch ini, ubah hanya logic checkpoint dan masalah regen. Biarkan environment art, dialog NPC, dan audio tetap seperti sekarang.
